views.text: In September 2022, Equity Mates said Vimy was acquired by Deep Yellow, with Vimy shareholders receiving 0.294 Deep Yellow shares each, implying 28.05 cents per Vimy share and representing a 35% premium, giving a clear reference point for price at the time.
